title: 5.6 Renowned Nutritionists in Ethiopia
description: Renowned nutritionists in Ethiopia and the role of nutritionists

questions.question: What is a nutritionist?
options: A researcher or scientist who studies nutrition and its effects on health
A person who grows food crops
questions.answer: A researcher or scientist who studies nutrition and its effects on health

questions.question: Ethiopia has contributed significantly to the field of nutrition through which type of traditional foods?
options: Nutritious traditional foods such as teff-based dishes
questions.answer: Nutritious traditional foods such as teff-based dishes

questions.question: Tikur teff is an Ethiopian grain known for being a rich source of which mineral?
questions.answer: Iron

questions.question: Nutritionists study the relationship between which two factors?
questions.answer: Diet and health

questions.question: Which nutrient found in abundance in Ethiopian teff is important for preventing anemia?
questions.answer: Iron

questions.question: Renowned nutritionists in Ethiopia have contributed to combating which of the following problems?
questions.answer: Malnutrition and micronutrient deficiencies

questions.question: The work of nutritionists in Ethiopia is important because:
options: They help improve public health by promoting balanced diets and preventing deficiency diseases
They focus exclusively on animal nutrition
questions.answer: They help improve public health by promoting balanced diets and preventing deficiency diseases

questions.question: Ethiopian nutritionists often emphasize the importance of which locally available foods in combating malnutrition?
options: Teff, beans, chickpeas, and other indigenous crops
questions.answer: Teff, beans, chickpeas, and other indigenous crops

questions.question: What role do nutritionists play in addressing public health issues?
options: They promote healthy eating habits, design nutritional programs, and advise communities on balanced diets
questions.answer: They promote healthy eating habits, design nutritional programs, and advise communities on balanced diets

questions.question: A key contribution of Ethiopian nutrition researchers is in the area of:
options: Addressing micronutrient deficiencies through locally available foods
questions.answer: Addressing micronutrient deficiencies through locally available foods

questions.question: Which mineral found in Ethiopian teff is essential for hemoglobin synthesis?
questions.answer: Iron

questions.question: Ethiopian nutritionists recommend a diet rich in which food group to prevent protein deficiency?
options: Legumes such as beans and chickpeas
questions.answer: Legumes such as beans and chickpeas

questions.question: The study of nutrition helps us understand:
options: How the body uses food for growth, energy, and health maintenance
questions.answer: How the body uses food for growth, energy, and health maintenance

questions.question: Why are indigenous Ethiopian foods like teff important in the context of nutrition?
options: They are nutrient-dense and help address malnutrition in a culturally acceptable way
They are the only foods available in Ethiopia
They are cheaper than all other foods
questions.answer: They are nutrient-dense and help address malnutrition in a culturally acceptable way

questions.question: Nutritionists contribute to the fight against malnutrition by:
options: Educating communities about balanced diets and food preparation
Performing laboratory tests on blood samples only
questions.answer: Educating communities about balanced diets and food preparation

questions.question: Which Ethiopian food crop is particularly rich in calcium and is promoted by nutritionists for bone health?
questions.answer: Teff

questions.question: The role of nutritionists in Ethiopia extends to advising which groups on proper dietary needs?
options: Pregnant women, nursing mothers, children, athletes, and people living with HIV/AIDS
questions.answer: Pregnant women, nursing mothers, children, athletes, and people living with HIV/AIDS

questions.question: Ethiopian nutrition research has contributed knowledge about the health benefits of:
options: Fermented foods like injera and their nutritional value
questions.answer: Fermented foods like injera and their nutritional value

questions.question: What type of nutrients do nutritionists recommend for preventing goiter?
options: Iodine-rich foods such as iodized salt and seafood
Iron-rich foods such as red meat
Vitamin C-rich foods such as oranges
questions.answer: Iodine-rich foods such as iodized salt and seafood

questions.question: A balanced diet according to Ethiopian nutritionists should emphasize:
options: A variety of locally available nutrient-dense foods in the right proportions
High amounts of sugar and fat
questions.answer: A variety of locally available nutrient-dense foods in the right proportions
